note: Every request URL is <base-url> + base_path + the operation path. The loopback mock in harness/MockVcfOnServer.java serves these three operations and nothing else; any other method+path pair is answered 404 with an ApiError body.

wire_rules.omit_unset_optionals: An optional query parameter or optional JSON body property that has no configured value MUST be omitted entirely. Sending the key with an empty, null, zero, or placeholder value is a contract violation. This applies to nested objects too: an object property that is present must itself contain only the sub-properties that are set.
wire_rules.no_duplicate_query_keys: A query parameter key MUST appear at most once per request.
wire_rules.query_key_order: The order of query parameters within a request is not constrained; the set of keys and their values is.
wire_rules.path_segments_verbatim: An entity id substituted into a path template is sent verbatim. Entity ids contain ':' which is a legal path character (RFC 3986 pchar); it MUST NOT be percent-encoded. The mock answers 404 for a percent-encoded id.
wire_rules.auth_header: Every operation except 'create' MUST send 'Authorization: NetworkInsight <token>' using the token returned by 'create'. Exactly one space separates the scheme from the token.
wire_rules.no_auth_header_on_token_request: The 'create' request MUST NOT send an Authorization header.
wire_rules.content_type: Requests carrying a JSON body MUST send 'Content-Type: application/json'. Requests with no body MUST NOT send a Content-Type header.

value.note: not required for the LOCAL domain

size.note: Page size of results. This client always sends it explicitly.

cursor.note: Opaque cursor copied verbatim from the previous response. MUST be absent on the first request of a walk.

modifiedAfter.note: Epoch-millis filter. Absent unless configured. When configured it is sent on every request of the walk, including cursor-bearing ones.

entity_name.note: This deployment does not populate it; the display name must come from getApplicationById.

pagination.first_request: Send 'size' (and 'modifiedAfter' when configured). Do not send 'cursor'.
pagination.next_request: Send the same parameters plus 'cursor' set verbatim to the 'cursor' value of the response just received.
pagination.termination: The walk ends when the response has no 'cursor' property, or its 'cursor' is the empty string. Both terminations occur in practice and both MUST be handled. After termination the client MUST NOT issue a further list request.
pagination.completeness: The number of collected entity ids MUST equal 'total_count'.

id.note: An entity_id from listApplications, sent verbatim.

call_discipline.one_per_entity: Exactly one request per distinct entity id returned by the walk. No repeats.
call_discipline.order: Requests are issued in list-discovery order: the order the entity ids appeared in the 'results' arrays, pages in the order they were fetched. Sorting happens after all detail responses are in hand, never by reordering the requests.
call_discipline.timing: All list pages MUST be walked to exhaustion before the first detail request is issued.
